status: declared before any evaluation; owner 24 Nov: 'do whatever best practice is and continue' -> observed lateral boundaries (regional-climate-model convention) for Earth cases, physics refitted under them; sealed V18 declared and unopened
method: scripts/ppe.py as W4/W5: Sobol wave 1 (64 + base), GP emulators per region, emulator waves of 16; close early when the predicted gain is within noise (sd ~0.005); at most 4 waves.
objective: S61 + 10 x (excess of S49 over 1.0 + excess of T and P over +1 %), all vs r53 at pad 1,100 km
gates: policy v5 against r53: dev5 (90 % bootstrap upper < 1), T and P <= +1 %, S49 <= 1, fine28 <= 1.01, ONE paired run on sealed V18 (S <= 1, 90 % lower < 1). Reported, not gating: regime scores. Pass -> r54 with edge_obs_pw as the Earth-calibration convention (the atlas world keeps its own edges), no atlas rebuild unless the owner asks.
cost: ~2 min per evaluation: wave 1 ~2.2 h, later waves ~35 min
note: With observed edge humidity the Amazon / Congo / Tripolitania / Nova Scotia gain 15-25 % but eastern Europe, the Kazakh steppe, the Sahara and Morocco lose 14-32 %, mostly temperature: r53's moisture, cloud and land-energy settings were fitted to dry (RH 0.5) edges. Refit them under the observed edges.
